description:
Permanently deletes an education record from the user's GigHQ profile.

CRITICAL: Confirm with the user before calling. This is a hard delete and cannot be undone (the backend route comment saying 'soft delete' is inaccurate).

Pass education_uuid (preferred) or education_id from list_education / get_profile.
